note: What a server sends when a unit comes into what one client can see.

bits.name: size
bits.note: How many bytes the messages below occupy in total. Zero in everything observed.

bits.name: unknown
bits.note: Purpose undetermined. A reading end takes no meaning from these.

fields.name: messages
fields.note: Whole messages of the same family, each behind its own length, that a client reads as though they had arrived on their own. No payload observed has carried any.

fields.name: maxHealth
fields.note: What the unit's health tops out at.
